# Foundation Requirements Quality Checklist: Project Foundation (Phase 0)

**Purpose**: Pre-implementation requirements-quality review of the Phase 0 specification — tests whether the requirements themselves are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and well-covered (not whether the implementation works)
**Created**: 2026-09-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all required environment variables enumerated in the requirements with their public/secret classification and intended consumers? [Completeness, Spec FR-006]
- [x] CHK002 Does the spec define the complete acceptance-gate sequence including the final "run tests" step? [Completeness, Spec FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for all three test levels (unit, database, end-to-end) with a minimum example count per level? [Completeness, Spec FR-013]
- [x] CHK004 Are all five baseline routes enumerated in the requirements rather than referenced only by example? [Completeness, Spec FR-012, FR-011]
- [x] CHK005 Is a single canonical data-layer change workflow required as the only allowed path, with alternatives explicitly disallowed? [Completeness, Spec FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "resettable to zero and fully rebuilt deterministically" specified precisely enough to verify (equivalent known-good state across repeated runs)? [Clarity, Spec FR-007, SC-003]
- [x] CHK007 Is the onboarding time target quantified with a measurable threshold, starting conditions, and the documentation-only constraint? [Clarity, SC-001]
- [x] CHK008 Is "distinct top-level area" for each application experience defined so placeholder views can be objectively distinguished during review? [Clarity, Spec FR-011, FR-012]
- [x] CHK009 Is the required content of a missing-configuration failure message specified (which values are missing, where to configure them)? [Clarity, Spec FR-016]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Is the backend environment (Supabase Cloud, no local stack, CLI scope limited to migrations/type-generation/synchronization) stated consistently across requirements, user stories, edge cases, and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec FR-004, FR-005, FR-007, Clarifications 2026-09-15]
- [x] CHK011 Do the success criteria remain technology-agnostic while requirements name only owner-mandated platform dependencies (GitHub, Supabase Cloud)? [Consistency, SC-001…SC-006 vs FR-001, FR-004]
- [x] CHK012 Is the out-of-scope boundary (no CI wiring, no containers, no business schema/RBAC/business UI) stated consistently with the constitution's minimal-complexity principle? [Consistency, Spec Out of Scope, Constitution VIII]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Is each success criterion independently verifiable without implementation knowledge? [Measurability, SC-001…SC-006]
- [x] CHK014 Is deterministic rebuild expressed as an objective comparison (repeated runs producing an equivalent state)? [Measurability, SC-003]
- [x] CHK015 Is the secrets criterion verifiable by inspection with a defined scope (untracked env files, template contents, committed history)? [Measurability, SC-006, FR-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are exception-flow requirements defined for an unreachable cloud project (network outage, paused project, wrong credentials)? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are recovery requirements defined for a partially migrated or unknown database state? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, FR-007]
- [x] CHK018 Are the preconditions for each test level required to be documented, including behavior when the cloud project is unreachable? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are requirements defined for missing or wrong-version prerequisites at onboarding (fail with actionable message vs. obscure downstream error)? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Is cross-platform support bounded explicitly (primary platform named, others called out or excluded)? [Edge Case, Spec Assumptions]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK021 Are security requirements for secret handling specified (template committed, secret files excluded from version control, no privileged credentials in frontend code)? [Security, Spec FR-006]
- [x] CHK022 Is the deny-by-default security posture of the baseline data object captured as a requirement, or is its delegation to the technical plan explicit? [Gap, Security, data-model.md]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK023 Are all assumptions documented and free of contradiction after the Supabase Cloud environment clarification (no local-backend remnants)? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, Clarifications 2026-09-15]
- [x] CHK024 Is access to the configured Supabase Cloud project (URL, anon key, project ref, database connection string) documented as a onboarding prerequisite with its source? [Dependency, Spec FR-005]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK025 Does any requirement permit or imply an alternative data-layer workflow that would conflict with the single canonical workflow rule? [Conflict, Spec FR-010]
- [x] CHK026 Are all four clarified decisions (GitHub remote, local-only pipeline, manual gate verification, Supabase Cloud backend) reflected in requirements with no contradictory earlier text remaining? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications 2026-09-15]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Context: generated as remediation for $speckit-analyze finding F2 (master plan §43 checklist gate); the spec was updated with the Supabase Cloud directive on 2026-09-15, and this checklist validates requirements quality against that current version
- Constraint honored: no CI, no containers, no architecture change — items test the existing requirements only
